**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Paragraph 22 of the APCN 2 Agreement satisfies the ASSIGN preferred position:

- **Affiliate/successor carve-out present** — §22.3 lets any Party assign the whole of its rights and obligations, at any time and without consent, to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate, or a sister company under the Parent. §22.4 and §22.5 add intra-group partial assignment rights.
- **Consent standard correct** — §22.2 requires Management Committee consent for other assignments, but "must not unreasonably withhold or delay its approval."
- **Notice only** — §22.6 requires timely written notice for the permitted transfers.
- **Symmetric** — the restriction in §22.1 binds all APCN 2 Parties equally, so it is not a one-sided constraint on Teleglobe.
- **No change-of-control trigger** — searches for "change of control" and "control" return nothing giving any Party a termination or re-pricing right on another Party's change of control, so the walk-away scenario does not arise. §30 binds successors and permitted assigns.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged: §22.3 covers only whole-interest assignments (partial intra-group assignments under §22.4 are once-per-Assignee and non-releasing), and there is no express bar on assignment to a competitor. Neither is material in a multilateral consortium cable agreement.
